_note: 名案事實庫。每個數字都附 quote(它出自哪一句)與 doi。2026-08-25 逐句人工核對。arc=pair 是原始 vs 大規模重測;arc=pooled 是沒有單一原始論文、直接看彙整結果。任何數字若不在本檔,寫稿端的 audit 會擋下來。

original.title: Ego depletion: Is the active self a limited resource?

test.title: A Multilab Preregistered Replication of the Ego-Depletion Effect
test.quote: Multiple laboratories (k = 23, total N = 2,141) conducted replications of a standardized ego-depletion protocol... the size of the ego-depletion effect was small with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) that encompassed zero ... (d = 0.04, 95% CI [-0.07, 0.15]) [Hagger et al. 2016, Table 1 / abstract]

test.title: Is Red Really Romantic?
test.quote: For men, we found a very weak effect in the predicted direction (d = 0.09, 95% CI [-0.17, 0.34], N = 242). For women, we found a very weak effect in the opposite direction (d = -0.09, 95% CI [-0.30, 0.12], N = 360).
test.n_total_note: 242 men + 360 women, reported separately. 合計值在此明確宣告,否則 audit 會擋(它只認事實庫裡有的數字)

episodes.title: A 1968 study said crowds stop people from helping. 105 effect sizes later, it is still there.

original.title: Bystander intervention in emergencies: Diffusion of responsibility.

test.title: The bystander-effect: A meta-analytic review on bystander intervention in dangerous and non-dangerous emergencies
test.quote: In a fixed effects model, data from over 7,700 participants and 105 independent effect sizes revealed an overall effect size of g = -0.35.
test.direction_note: g 為負 = 旁觀者越多、出手相助越少,即效應存在的方向

episodes.claim: playing a sound during sleep can strengthen the memory you learned it with
episodes.title: Can you strengthen a memory while you sleep? 91 experiments say yes — by this much.

test.title: Promoting memory consolidation during sleep: A meta-analysis of targeted memory reactivation.
test.quote: Here we present the first meta-analysis of sleep TMR, compiled from 91 experiments with 212 effect sizes (N = 2,004). ... overall sleep TMR was highly effective (Hedges' g = 0.29, 95% CI [0.21, 0.38])

episodes.hook: Can a sound you learned with strengthen that memory in your sleep?

episodes.claim: a reaction-time test can reveal the hidden bias behind how people behave, judge, and react
episodes.title: The hidden-bias test predicts behaviour at r = .27. The questionnaire does better.

test.title: Understanding and using the Implicit Association Test: III. Meta-analysis of predictive validity.
test.quote: This review of 122 research reports (184 independent samples, 14,900 subjects) found average r = .274 for prediction of behavioral, judgment, and physiological measures. Parallel explicit (i.e., self-report) measures, available in 156 of these samples (13,068 subjects), also predicted effectively (average r = .361)
test.outcome_note: r = .274 是 behavioral / judgment / physiological 三類量測的合成,不只是行為
test.second_note: ⚠️ .361 來自 156 個樣本 / 13,068 人,與 .274 的 184 個樣本 / 14,900 人**不是同一組**,旁白必須講明,不能直接並排說 Higher

episodes.hook: Does the hidden-bias test predict what people actually do?

_hook_note: hook = 標題用的短主題(手寫)。FReD 的 description 常常太長,截斷後會失去意義;名案只有 5 集,值得手寫一個唸得順又點得下去的版本。
_cited_by_note: 引用數是全片唯一一個觀眾自己去查會查到不同答案的數字(Google Scholar / Crossref / Scopus 差很多),所以一律標明來源與抓取日期,文案用「over N」不用精確值。
